scope: Fresh packaged Linux x64 profiles; built-ins enabled; no third-party installs; startup, local actions and normal quit. First run uses preceding Linux artifact; second uses rebuilt 936dd77b0b0 artifact. Chromium completed logs in both runs have no URL hosts.
limitations: One-second socket snapshots of discovered processes can miss startup races, short-lived processes/sockets and DNS/unconnected UDP. Chromium omits Node/native transports. This is not packet or payload capture, nor proof of universal zero traffic.
